projecthero.power.power_01_super_strengt: Super Strength
Enhanced physiology: devastating melee force, mobility, grabbing and tanking damage.
Experimental Adrenal Serum
Drink the serum, then take an electrical surge from an Overloaded Redstone Coil (or a natural lightning strike).
Ground Slam

R: 14 damage in a 5-block radius, slows for 2s and launches enemies 3 blocks up. Used airborne it becomes a dive that hits harder the farther you fell (up to 28) and shrugs off the landing. Leaves the ground intact.
Air Punch
G: instantly punch a slug of compressed air down your line of sight — 16 damage and a wall-of-wind shove. 10s cooldown.
Power Leap
X: hold to charge, release to launch yourself the way you are looking — 11 blocks at a tap, up to 38 fully charged. No fall damage on landing.
Bull Rush

Z: hold for 5s to charge (25% damage / full knockback resistance while charging), then plough forward for 8s at double sprint speed with 4-block step assist, hitting everything in your path for 20 and a 5-block knockback. Sneak + hold Z for 5s = Impact Smash: 60 damage in a 20-block radius that shatters blocks. Releasing early cancels. Bull Rush and Impact Smash share one cooldown.
Grab & Carry
V: grab a mob or player (no damage) and carry them. Press again to hurl them where you aim, or sneak + V to set them down gently.
Maximum Effort
C: 22 seconds of everything turned up — stronger abilities, more damage, more resistance, faster, and halved ability cooldowns. 60s cooldown.
Unarmed hits deal 12 damage with +150% knockback; a held tool adds its own damage on top
15% less damage from all sources, 20% less from explosions, 70% knockback resistance
Jump roughly 2 blocks high
Your fists count as a stone tool whatever you're holding; +25% mining speed, +15% sprint speed, +30% swim speed
65% less fall damage

Hold the attack key for 2s (not while aimed at a block you could mine), then release for a Charged Punch: 20 damage to whatever is in front of you, massive knockback, disables shields. 2.5s cooldown — you can keep winding it up while it recharges. The Bull Rush / Impact Smash cooldown now shows on the Z keybind.
A photonic mutation turning the eyes into precision tools, combat beams and high-output weapons.
Drink the serum and look into an active Experimental Light Projector / Beacon Lens for several seconds.

Hold to fire two continuous energy streams from your eyes: 4 damage every half-second, and ignites targets. Shift + R switches to utility mode, mining blocks as fast as a diamond tool but burning heat 50% faster.
Hold to charge, up to 3s: a 1s charge deals 20 damage (9s cooldown), 2s deals 22 (10s), 3s deals 24 (12s). A bar shows the charge.
Instant short-range eye blast for 16 damage that knocks nearby enemies away and ignites them.
Hold Z for 5s, gathering heat-vision particles at your eyes, then unleash a thick, extreme-damage beam with fire and periodic impact bursts. 65s cooldown.
Low-power utility beam: light TNT, melt ice/snow, break glass.
Toggle thermal highlighting of nearby living entities, through limited cover.
Completely immune to blindness and darkness
Your eyes visibly glow while a laser ability is active, you see clearly in darkness, and a subtle reticle marks any creature you look at
projecthero.power.power_03_flight.name: Flight
projecthero.power.power_03_flight.desc: True superhero aerial movement: dashes, hovering and high-speed bursts.
projecthero.power.power_03_flight.trigge: Drink the serum on an activated Unstable Gravity Plate or inside a Gravity Distortion Rig.
projecthero.power.power_03_flight.abilit: Rapid forward aerial dash that preserves momentum.
Plunge dead straight down, all the way to the ground, then detonate. The impact scales with how far you fell (up to 70 damage in a 12-block radius).
Enable or disable superhero flight. Cruises at ~15 blocks/second, ~25 while sprinting.
Up to 25s of ~50 blocks/second supersonic flight trailing a roaring vapour wake, throwing 9-damage shockwaves. Press again to end it early; the cooldown only starts once it ends.
Scoop up the creature or player you are looking at and carry them with you as you fly; press again to set them down.
Powerful vertical launch that immediately gains altitude.
projecthero.power.power_03_flight.passiv: Improved aerial control while falling -- steer your descent and fall more slowly
Full fall-damage immunity while flight is unlocked
projecthero.power.power_04_super_speed.d: A speedster mutation: traversal, combat bursts, evasion and momentum.
projecthero.power.power_04_super_speed.t: Drink the serum and sprint across a run of powered/charged copper plates.
projecthero.power.power_04_super_speed.a: Snatch up the creature or player you are looking at and run with them held in front of you. It is a carry, not an attack: press again to simply set them down unharmed -- no throw, no damage.
A burst of multiple rapid strikes to nearby valid targets.
Instant directional dodge based on current movement. In speed modes, jumps also keep their momentum for long leaps.

For 30s: sprint at roughly 64 blocks/second (a faster tier that replaces Speed Mode while it runs), +150% attack speed, a 10-block step assist, fall immunity, and every Super Speed move hits twice as hard. A bar shows the time left (50s cooldown).
Hold to spin, for up to 8s (shown on a bar), flinging back enemies and projectiles and putting out fire. 12s cooldown on release.
Toggle: sprint at roughly 32 blocks/second, +50% attack speed, run on water, 2-block step, +100% swim speed, -80% fall damage. Sprinting while it is on leaves a speed trail at your feet.
projecthero.power.power_04_super_speed.p: Your base movement speed is normal -- speed comes from Speed Mode and Overdrive

Higher step-up capability at speed. Sprint into a wall while looking steeply up it and you run straight up instead of stalling -- with a generous step assist so an overhanging lip or the rim of a deep hole doesn't stop you at the top.
projecthero.power.power_05_geokinesis.de: Control stone, dirt and earth as a battlefield weapon and defensive tool.
projecthero.power.power_05_geokinesis.tr: Drink while standing on natural stone/deepslate, ideally in a Geological Resonance Chamber.
projecthero.power.power_05_geokinesis.ab: R: rip a rock from the ground and fire it for 9 damage. Sneak + R shakes the ground in a 10-block cone ahead of you — everything caught takes 9 damage and is slowed for 2s (10s cooldown).

G: stone spikes erupt beneath the targeted point (17 direct / 10 splash). Sneak + G auto-tracks every enemy in a 10-block cone, dropping a dripstone spike at their feet for 15 damage and slowness (22s cooldown).

X: a 4x4 rock wall for 25s. Look up for a dome (left-click to drop it), look down for a bridge. Sneak + look straight down: 20s of rock flight — the X slot is locked out entirely for the flight’s duration. Sneak + X otherwise: Earth Swim — phase down into natural ground and swim through the earth for 12s, taking no damage from anything while submerged. Inside the earth you move fast; break the surface and you slow to a crawl until you sink back in. 30s cooldown.

Z: hold for 5s to charge, then a seismic pulse for 45 damage across a 25-block radius that rips deep ravines out of the ground around you — the pad under your feet stays solid. 65s cooldown. While a boulder is lifted, hold Z instead for Colossal Rock: a giant boulder launched at ghast-fireball speed that detonates on the first thing it hits for 50 damage and craters the terrain (Z 90s / Boulder Lift 25s cooldown).

V: tear a boulder of real rock out of the ground and carry it over your head as long as you like (Slowness I while held). Press again to hurl it for 20 damage. Hold one and Z becomes Colossal Rock instead of Earthquake.

C: toggle stone plating — heavy defense, reduced speed, +10 ability damage and +8 melee. Drains a strain bar (~25s) that recharges once dropped; deactivating it (even early) puts the slot on a 20s cooldown.
projecthero.power.power_05_geokinesis.pa: Iron-tool hands whatever you hold; earth-family blocks break 50% faster; a bare-handed hit on an ore mines the whole vein. Sneak + right-click the ground empty-handed for Seismic Sense — every creature within 30 blocks is outlined for 12s.
projecthero.power.power_06_crystalkinesi: An amethyst/crystal power set: sharp projectiles, prisons, barriers and reflective armor.
Drink inside a natural Amethyst Geode or a functioning crystal chamber.
R: fire a fast, sharp crystal projectile for 11 damage and brief slowness. Sneak + R fires a volley of 5 crystal shards one after another (10s cooldown).
G: grow a cluster of crystals beneath targeted enemies. Sneak + G auto-tracks every enemy in a 10-block cone, raising a crystal spike at their feet for 15 damage and slowness (22s cooldown).

X: a temporary translucent crystal shield — look up for a dome, down for a bridge, level for a wall. Sneak + look straight down: Crystal Skate — glide forward across a trail of crystal until you press X again to stop (8s cooldown once stopped).

Z: hold for 5s to charge, then a burst for 40 damage across a 20-block radius that raises a dense field of amethyst pillars (no loose shards). 70s cooldown. Sneak + hold Z for Colossal Crystal: a giant crystal launched at ghast-fireball speed for 55 damage (100s cooldown).
Seal a target in an amethyst cage for 7s with Slowness X and a jump lock — they cannot move at all.

C: toggle crystal plating — defense, knockback resistance, +10 ability damage and +8 melee. Drains a strain bar (~25s) that recharges once dropped; deactivating it (even early) puts the slot on a 20s cooldown.
Reduced damage from amethyst/crystal hazards you create
projecthero.power.power_07_electrokinesi: A general electricity mutation - intentionally weaker than Thor’s true lightning.
Drink the serum and activate an Overloaded Redstone Coil while inside its discharge radius.

Fire a quick 10-damage electrical bolt that stuns the target and briefly powers nearby redstone. Shift + R instead fires a Chain Bolt: 9 damage per hop, arcing to every other target within 8 blocks of each link.

Release lightning around you for 18 damage in a 20-block radius, stunning everything it hits and powering nearby redstone. 10s cooldown. Shift + G instead fires an EMP: disables redstone contraptions, powered doors, minecarts and technological enemies in a 20-block range for 6 seconds. 30s cooldown.
Short high-speed electrical dash with brief collision immunity.
Hold Z for 5 seconds, gathering lightning particles, then call down one enormous bolt at the aimed point for 55 damage, blasting a small crater and stunning everything hit. 65s cooldown.
Energise redstone from up to 50 blocks away — plants a short-lived block of redstone against whatever you are looking at.
Toggle: +10 ability damage, +8 melee damage, Speed III, and a live-current body. Drains your charge cell (~25s); getting hit while charged costs you 5 health and staggers you.
Lightning deals no damage to you at all; standing near a lightning strike instantly refills your charge cell

Every ability spends from a 1000-point charge cell that regenerates on its own, far faster during a thunderstorm. Attacks stun their targets, every ability briefly powers nearby redstone, and powered rails energise as you run over them.
projecthero.power.power_08_pyrokinesis.d: Direct heat and flame control: ranged fire, mobility and an aggressive flame-body stance.
projecthero.power.power_08_pyrokinesis.t: Drink the serum and remain in ordinary fire for several seconds while resistance protects you.
projecthero.power.power_08_pyrokinesis.a: R: hurl a heavy ghast fireball that craters the ground and scatters fire on impact. A direct hit deals 12 fire damage (more in the Nether). In Blue Flame stance it becomes an instant flame laser — a hitscan beam that still detonates a crater and burns, for extra damage.
G: hold to project continuous flame for 6 damage a tick. The heat gauge climbs while you fire (~13s to overheat, then it cuts out); it vents back down whenever you are not firing.
Use a fire burst to launch rapidly where you aim -- and take no fall damage for 10 seconds afterward. Sneak while looking down for 20 seconds of flame flight.

Z: hold for 5s to charge a colossal flying fireball. 55s cooldown. In Blue Flame stance it instead becomes a Lightning Arc — 60 damage, a 10s stun and 10s of heavy decay — but it burns out the whole Flame Body reserve and locks its regen for a minute (95s cooldown).
A flint-and-steel in your hand: light fires, TNT, campfires and nether portals. Sneak + use to pull in nearby fire and cook every raw item in your hand.

C: toggle Blue Flame stance — fire immunity, +10 ability damage, +8 melee, a trail of fire underfoot, everything within 3 blocks alight, and anything you set on fire burns far hotter. Your Fireball becomes a flame laser and your Ultimate becomes the Lightning Arc. Bleeds the heat reserve (~35s), which refills once dropped; deactivating it (even early) puts the slot on a 20s cooldown.
projecthero.power.power_08_pyrokinesis.p: Strong or permanent fire resistance depending on balance mode
projecthero.power.power_09_cryokinesis.d: Ice control: freezing, terrain creation, defensive walls and fast ice traversal.
projecthero.power.power_09_cryokinesis.t: Drink the serum while submerged in Powder Snow for several seconds.
projecthero.power.power_09_cryokinesis.a: R: fire a chilling projectile that builds freeze on targets. Sneak + R opens a weapon wheel to shape the ice tool of your choice: iron mining level, 32 uses.

G: hold a beam that freezes and slows enemies for 5 damage a hit, snuffs out fire, turns lava it washes over to stone, and lays powder snow on the ground where it lands. Channelling chills you — the cold gauge climbs (~4s to frostbite) and thaws back down while idle.
Conjure ice underfoot (even in mid-air) and skate 150% faster. Jump to rise, hold sneak to descend.

Z: hold for 5s to charge (snow swirls up around you), then a 20-block flash-freeze for 35 damage that blankets the whole radius in snow, sheets water to ice and seals every target in a shell of ice. 45s cooldown.

V: a large temporary wall of ice (look up for a dome, down for a bridge). Sneak + look down: a field of jagged ice spikes. Sneak + V: flash-freeze every target within 10 blocks, pinning them in place for 8s and putting out fire (20s cooldown).

C: toggle ice plating — defense, +10 ability damage, +8 melee, every hit maxes a target's freeze, everything within 6 blocks is flash-frozen, and you leave snow underfoot. Bleeds the cold reserve (~35s), which refills once dropped; deactivating it (even early) puts the slot on a 20s cooldown.
projecthero.power.power_09_cryokinesis.p: Walk on powder snow with no leather boots, and move through a drift at full speed instead of wading
projecthero.power.power_10_telekinesis.d: Psionic force manipulation, all of it drawn from one Psi reserve: push, pull, levitate, crush, and tear the ground itself out and throw it. Empty the reserve and the power shuts down for ten seconds.
projecthero.power.power_10_telekinesis.t: Drink the serum near an active Enchanting Table with enough bookshelves to trigger a psionic resonance.
projecthero.power.power_10_telekinesis.a: 10 damage and a hard shove to the entity you are aiming at, plus anything within 3 blocks of it. 1s cooldown. Sneak for Force Pull instead: reels in a target and every loose item within 50 blocks.
A toggled shell of pure force. Nothing gets through while it holds -- but it burns Psi the whole time, and every blow it eats costs extra. Break your reserve on it and you burn out.
Levitate telekinetically. A low, steady Psi drain, so flight itself is cheap; holding a grabbed target or a lifted block on top of it is what costs.

Hold Z for 5s: everything within 50 blocks is torn off the ground and hauled toward you, held at arm’s length, then blown apart for 55 damage. 90s cooldown, an enormous Psi cost, and your reserve crawls back for 10s afterwards.

Hold a target up to 50 blocks away in the air; press again to throw. Sneak + press sets them down unharmed instead. Sneak with nothing held to Force Crush: reel a victim in and squeeze for 10 damage a second while it drains Psi and roots you in place.
Lift a block up to 50 blocks away and steer it with your crosshair; release to throw. Sneak to tear a 3x3 chunk out of the ground instead -- a thrown chunk hits far harder than a single block.
projecthero.power.power_10_telekinesis.p: Nearby dropped items drift slightly toward you while charged
Every telekinetic ability is paid for out of one large Psi reserve, which refills by itself
You never take fall damage — but catching yourself draws Psi in proportion to the fall
projecthero.power.power_11_teleportation: Short-range spatial distortion: combat blinks, marks and limited wall phasing.
Drink the serum and throw/use an Ender Pearl while the effect is active.
Short teleport toward the crosshair, stopping safely before invalid blocks.
Teleport to a safe position behind a targeted enemy.
Instant short teleport backward from your facing.

Hold for 5 seconds to charge (a bar shows the charge), then pick an exact destination -- coordinates and dimension -- in a screen. A linked pair of gateways forms slowly out of particles: one where you stand, one at the destination. Step into either to travel to the other. The pair stays open until you sneak + right-click a gate to close it, or you lose the power. 60s cooldown.
Place one return marker; activate again to return if the spot is still valid. Works across dimensions — a marker set in the Nether always brings you back to the Nether, wherever you press the key.

Press to place anchor A on the block you are looking at, press again for anchor B. The two link into a permanent portal that works across dimensions -- anyone who steps into one end comes out the other. Sneak + right-click either end to remove the pair; they also vanish if you lose the power.
message.projecthero.teleport.anchor_full: Both portal anchors are placed (sneak + right-click one to remove)
projecthero.power.power_12_super_regener: Aggressive cellular regeneration: fast passive healing that hunger never stops (it only slows in a fight), plus half-length negative effects.
While the serum is active, survive being reduced below 3 hearts without dying.
Instantly restore a burst of health.
Remove selected negative effects such as Poison, Weakness and Slowness.
Immediate recovery and short resistance after heavy recent damage.
Automatic: dying triggers full totem-of-undying protection, then a one-minute cooldown. Nothing to press.
An extra 1 HP every 0.25s for 30 seconds on top of your regeneration, plus a movement and mining boost.
Toggle an extra 1 HP every 0.25s; the only Super Regeneration ability that burns hunger (saturation every 5s).
Passive regeneration: 4 HP/s out of combat (and whenever below 4 hearts), 2 HP/s while in combat — hunger never stops it
Poison, Wither, Weakness, Slowness, Mining Fatigue, Nausea and Hunger last only half as long
projecthero.power.power_13_super_durabil: A tank mutation hardening the body against damage, knockback, projectiles and explosions.
Drink the serum and survive an explosion from TNT or a controlled blast chamber.
Reinforced melee hit with extra stagger.
Rush forward through enemies, dealing collision damage and knockback.
Hold to cut damage from the frontal 180° arc by a further 60%; drains the guard bar.
Ignore 100% of all damage for 15 seconds.
Hold to swat away nearby projectiles and be immune to them; drains the guard bar.
Toggle a reinforced stance: a further 30% damage reduction and knockback resistance, lower speed.
40% less damage from all sources, with 70% less fall damage and heavy explosion resistance
14 hearts of base health and 85% knockback resistance
Manipulate destructive sound: cones, focused blasts, mobility and sonar-like utility.
Use a Goat Horn while the serum is active, ideally inside a resonant room/chamber.
A quick cone-shaped sound attack for 10 damage with knockback. 5s cooldown.
A long-range concentrated sonic beam for 16 damage. 10s cooldown.
Blast sound downward to launch into the air — and take no fall damage from the landing. Also boosts an open elytra forward.

Hold Z for 5 seconds -- sonic sound effects and cues build as you charge -- then unleash a devastating 20-block cone of sound for 50 damage, with severe knockback and glass-breaking. 70s cooldown. Shift + Z instead charges for 5s into a 40-damage blast in a 20-block radius around you. 80s cooldown.
Vibrate selected fragile/compatible blocks until they break.

Toggle: you go blind, but every other move sharpens -- +15 ability damage, +8 melee damage, and longer ability range. Anything that gets within 5 blocks of you is blinded too. A bar drains over 15s of use and recharges (and disappears) while off; ending the mode always pays a 20s cooldown, even if you end it early.

Greatly reduced self-damage from sonic effects. Enhanced hearing: anything living within 40 blocks flashes for you alone the instant it moves. Shift + right-click makes everything within 20 blocks glow for you alone for a few seconds.
projecthero.power.power_15_invisibility_: Bend light for stealth, flashes, mirages and limited offensive photonic attacks.
Drink under direct sunlight with an unobstructed sky for several seconds.
Fire a compact burst of concentrated light for 10 damage.
Sear nearby enemies for 8 damage and blind and slow them for 10 seconds.
Hold to fly wherever you look; your body scatters into light while it lasts. Drains the sparkle meter (~25s), which refills on its own. 3s cooldown once you land.
Channel a single blinding pillar of light for 3 seconds — heavy continuous beam damage plus periodic radiant bursts where it lands.
Create a temporary visual duplicate that attracts hostile attention.
Sustained full invisibility — your armour vanishes too, so nothing shows. Attacking or heavy damage briefly reveals you.
projecthero.power.power_16_spider_climbi: Cling to any surface and move across it. Turn the grip on, then double-tap jump against a wall or ceiling to grab it -- climb up, crawl sideways, hang still, and double-tap sneak (or jump) to let go. Slower and less sure-footed than the arachnid who evolves out of it.
Get hit by a Cave Spider while the serum is active and survive the poison.
Hit a target and briefly stick/root it against a nearby surface.
Launch toward the aimed target or surface.
Powerfully launch away from the surface you are gripping.
Temporary enhanced agility: rapid climbing, wall-running, attack speed and leaps.

Arm the grip. With it on, double-tap jump against a wall or ceiling to stick, then look where you want to go and move relative to the surface. Stop and you stay put; sneak and you hold tighter. Double-tap sneak, or reach the ground, to let go.
The same grip, armed permanently -- double-tap jump against walls, overhangs and ceilings to hold them, double-tap sneak or jump to let go.
projecthero.power.power_17_elasticity.de: Rubber-like body manipulation: ranged punches, bouncing, grabs and slingshot movement.
projecthero.power.power_17_elasticity.tr: While affected, fall at least 10 blocks onto a Slime Block and survive the rebound.
projecthero.power.power_17_elasticity.ab: Long-reach melee strike, 12 damage. Hold to charge (a bar shows the charge): +5 damage per second, up to +10 at 2s. Every extra second held adds a second of cooldown.
On the ground: a heavy forward smash, 17 damage in a 4-block ball, 7 blocks out. More than 5 blocks up: plunge straight down for a 20-damage ground pound.
Anchor and launch. Aimed at terrain you reel yourself to it; aimed at a creature you anchor onto THEM, are hauled in at speed, and slam into them for 14 damage.
Massively enlarge an arm and slam the ground: 34 damage in a 4.5-block area, plus Slowness.
Stretch an arm to pull a mob, player or item toward you; press again to hurl them for 7 damage.

Toggle a body shape. All three shapes deflect projectiles outright. Plain C is Elastic: +reach, +speed, Jump Boost, +8 ability damage and +5 melee damage, melee attackers bounce off, and while you hold the jump key your landings rebound like a slime block. Shift + C opens a wheel to switch to Inflated (wider, slower, Slowness II, -50% damage taken, 100% knockback resistance, attackers flung 10 blocks) or Compression (one block tall, +25% move speed).
projecthero.power.power_17_elasticity.pa: A real fall (about 5 blocks or more) gives a small bounce on landing
Squeeze through a one-block gap without needing a trapdoor
projecthero.power.power_18_density_manip: Switch between low and high density for mobility, heavy impacts, defense and limited phasing.
Activate a Molecular Compression Chamber while the serum is active.
Raise your density by 5% (up to 300%). Higher density: more damage dealt, less taken, more knockback resistance, but slower.
Lower your density by 5% (down to 25%). Lower density: faster, but you deal less damage, take more, and are thrown further.
Slam to maximum density and root in place for 10s: cannot be moved by mobs, immune to knockback, 60% damage reduction, but cannot sprint or jump. A 30s cooldown starts when it ends.

More than 6 blocks up: slam straight down for 45 damage in a 20-block radius (falls off with distance) and shatter some ground. On the ground: launch upward, then slam -- the rise only ever lasts 3 seconds before the slam forces itself, so you are never left stranded in the sky.
Drop straight to 25% density -- maximum speed, minimum weight.

Toggle: vibrate and walk straight through solid blocks while the phase meter lasts. You are immune to all damage while phasing, and you render see-through so everyone can tell. This is intangibility, not flight — you cannot rise more than 2 blocks above the ground beneath you. Jump to rise, sneak to sink; your head buried in a block costs air.
Your density (25%-300%) sets your speed, damage dealt, damage taken and knockback -- shown on the HUD
projecthero.power.power_19_shadow_manipu: Use darkness as a resource for bolts, tendrils, movement, clones and concealment.
Drink at night while standing in true darkness (light level 0) for several seconds.
Fire a dark-energy bolt for 8 damage that blinds the target for 7 seconds.
Lash nearby enemies for 10 damage, blinding them for 7 seconds and dragging them in.
A plain 25-block blink in the direction you are looking. 4s cooldown (halved in darkness).
25s of a personal darkness field with speed and strength; the bar shows time left. Press again to end early — the 50s cooldown only starts once it ends.
Pin the target in place and blind them for 7 seconds, wrapped in a shroud of shadow.
Toggle stealth bonuses in darkness: partial invisibility, speed, reduced mob detection.
Stronger ability regeneration in darkness; weaker in bright sunlight
projecthero.power.power_20_energy_absorp: Convert incoming heat, explosions and electricity into a stored meter for offensive discharge.
While the serum is active, survive at least two different energy-like damage sources.
Spend a little stored energy on a ranged 8-damage bolt.
Spend stored energy on a sustained beam.
A short charged lunge with brief damage resistance. 3s cooldown.
Detonate all stored energy: 1 damage for every percent the 500-point bar is charged, and the blast (and crater) grows the fuller it is.
Hold while looking at a powered block (redstone, glowstone, lava, lit campfire) to siphon it into your meter. Also acts as an absorption shield while held. 3s cooldown on release.
Toggle passive partial absorption of fire, lightning, explosions and energy attacks. Bleeds the meter very slowly and charges your melee hits with an energy jolt.
500-point Energy Meter; high charge produces a cosmetic aura
projecthero.power.power_21_shockwave_man: Amplify kinetic force into pressure waves, repulsion and charged impacts.
Drink the serum and survive a TNT explosion or controlled blast chamber.
Punch to send a short pressure wave forward for 8 damage.
Strike the ground and send a traveling shockwave along the surface for 12 damage.
Blast yourself up and forward like a super-leap — no fall damage on landing. Built Charge launches you further.
Release a huge spherical shockwave around you for 35 damage.
Hold to keep a bubble up that constantly shoves entities and projectiles away. Drains a repulsion bank (~13s) that refills while not held.
Hold to build kinetic energy; the next Shockwave Punch, Ground Wave, Recoil Jump or Kinetic Detonation gains extra strength and range.
Slight knockback resistance from internal kinetic control
projecthero.power.power_22_plant_manipul: Control vines, roots and rapid growth for crowd control, movement, protection and regeneration.
Drink beneath open sky while surrounded by natural plant blocks, flowers or saplings.
Fire a sharp plant projectile for 8 damage and Poison II for 8 seconds.
Vines seize a target for 12 damage and root them in place for 8 seconds.
Attach a vine line to a block up to 100 blocks away and swing toward it.
Explosive growth in a 10-block radius: 27 damage, Poison V for 10 seconds, and a dense thicket that recedes after a few seconds.
Conjure a wall of leaves — look up for a dome, look down for a bridge. Sneak instead to charge your touch with bone meal for 30 seconds.
Toggle: while standing on grass/moss or within 5 blocks of any plant or leaf, gain Regeneration II and +8 to all ability and melee damage.
Bone meal interactions are more efficient
projecthero.power.power_23_gravity_manip: Control local gravity to push, crush, levitate and create dangerous gravity wells.
Drink inside an active Gravity Distortion Rig or complete a controlled low-gravity drop test.
A focused gravity pulse that throws targets away for 9 damage.
Pin a target under crushing gravity for 10 seconds — 4 damage a second and slowed the whole time.
Temporarily reduce personal gravity for floating and aerial repositioning.
Become a black hole for 12 seconds: invulnerable, dragging every creature within 10 blocks inward and crushing whatever comes close for 15 damage a second. You stay grounded.
Lift the target in front of you and hold it on your aim; activate again to hurl it.
Cycle personal Low / Normal / High gravity with different mobility and combat effects.
Reduced fall damage in Low gravity mode
projecthero.power.power_24_wind_manipula: Air-pressure control: blades, tornadoes, flight-like movement and projectile defense.
Drink inside an active Pressure Chamber / Industrial Fan Array.
R: fire a compressed blade of air. Sneak + hold R for 2s: a wide wind blade that pierces every enemy in a corridor for 16 damage (22s cooldown).
A roaming funnel that sucks entities in, spins and lifts them, and grinds them for 6 seconds.
Use controlled air currents for limited flight/propulsion.
Z: hold for 5s to charge, then an 11-second howling storm around you — 8 damage a second in a 15-block radius, projectiles thrown back. 60s cooldown.
A powerful defensive gust that repels mobs and projectiles.

C: toggle a supporting wind current — faster movement, high jumps, a 2-block step, +10 ability damage, +8 melee, and a gust that shoves anything within 2 blocks away. Drains a wind bank (~20s) that refills once dropped; deactivating it (even early) puts the slot on a 20s cooldown.
80% less fall damage, 30% faster sprint, a 3-block jump, sneak-fall gliding, rocket-free elytra boosts, and you drown 50% slower
projecthero.power.power_25_water_manipul: Control water into projectiles, whips, prisons and movement; be extremely capable underwater.
Drink the serum and remain fully submerged for roughly a minute, or use a Hydrostatic Test Tank.

R: tap to fire a high-pressure jet for 8 damage. Sneak + hold R to spray a stream that puts out fire and deals 5 damage, draining a water bar (like the flamethrower / ice beam) that refills while idle.
A sweeping water lash that damages and pulls targets.
Fire yourself along a jet of water in a fast forward dash. Goes further while wet, and bowls over anything in the way.
Z: hold for 5s to charge, then a 35-damage surge of water that sweeps everything caught in it off in the direction you aimed, across a large area. 45s cooldown.

V: seal a target in water for 8s — pinned in place but not drowned. Press again to free them early. Sneak + hold V for 4s to shape a water source where you look; right-click a water source while it charges to siphon that source away instead.
C: toggle an enhanced aquatic state — doubled water buffs, +10 ability damage and +8 melee. Deactivating it puts the slot on a 20s cooldown.
No drowning while Aquatic Form is active
projecthero.power.power_26_magnetic_mani: Manipulate magnetically reactive metal for combat and movement. Your abilities require actual magnetic material in the environment or on your enemies. Copper and gold are not magnetically reactive; netherite can be manipulated but strongly resists magnetic force.
Drink between two powered Electromagnetic Coils or inside a Magnetic Test Rig.

Launch a nearby magnetic object — a block you look at, a dropped metal item, or a nearby metal block — toward your crosshair. Heavier objects fly slower but hit far harder (iron nugget ~6, iron block ~18, anvil/netherite block ~28). Fails with no cooldown if there is no magnetic metal in reach.
Grab a magnetic block, dropped item, minecart or iron golem and float it on your aim. Heavier objects follow more sluggishly; netherite resists. Activate again to hurl it forward.

Pull yourself rapidly toward a magnetic object you are looking at, up to 24 blocks. Preserves momentum and cushions the landing briefly — chain leaps between metal to travel. Fails with no cooldown if nothing magnetic is targeted.

Gather up to 8 nearby magnetic objects into a violent orbit, then launch them at whatever you aim toward. Each object's damage scales with its mass; damage to any one target is capped so it can't instantly delete an enemy. Needs at least 2 magnetic objects nearby.

Use the magnetic metal an enemy wears or holds against them — crushing damage that scales with how much they carry (one item ~7, full iron armour ~19), plus Slowness and Weakness, and a hard immobilise at 3+ pieces. Netherite takes less damage but is still locked down. No metal on the target means no effect and no cooldown.

Toggle: highlight nearby magnetically reactive objects — iron blocks and ore, iron bars, chains, anvils, rails, lanterns, minecarts, lodestone, netherite, dropped iron, and metal-equipped enemies. Copper and gold are never highlighted.
Nearby dropped magnetic items drift toward you; controlled objects can't hurt you
Objects you are currently controlling never damage their owner
projecthero.power.power_27_size_manipula: Change body scale for stealth, mobility or giant strength - neither form universally superior.
Drink inside a Mass Compression Chamber (Government Experiment Sites) or a craftable late-iron-tier version.
Enlarge the striking arm for a wide sweeping hit — its reach scales with how big you are (roughly 4x in Giant form).
Stomp for a ground shockwave whose radius scales with your size (much wider as a giant).
Toggle (X): shrink to about half a block tall, in a puff of particles. Press again for normal size.

Toggle (Z): grow to ~15 blocks tall in a burst of particles — ~16-block reach, +15 damage on every move, 3-block leaps, and creatures you walk over are trampled. Drains a size-strain bar (~23s); once you shrink back it slowly recharges on its own.
While small or normal, rapidly shrink/dash through a narrow gap or under attacks.
Toggle (C): grow to about 6 blocks tall in a burst of particles — ~7-block reach, a wide pickup radius, and 3-block leaps. Press again for normal size.
Form-dependent reach, speed, step height and hitbox changes

projecthero.guide.overview.body: HeroPack turns Minecraft into a superhero sandbox. Alongside iconic heroes like Thor, you can undergo experimental mutations to permanently gain one of 27 minor powers, each with six abilities on a shared control scheme.
projecthero.guide.controls.title: Controls
projecthero.guide.controls.body: Every power uses the same six ability keys. What each key does depends on your active power (or on Thor, when you hold Mjolnir).
projecthero.guide.controls.select: H   HeroPack: Select Power - switch which mutation occupies the six slots. Never uses R/G/X/Z/V/C.
projecthero.guide.controls.info: I   Your Power - open a quick reference for your active power and its six abilities.
projecthero.guide.controls.squad: P   Squad - team roster: teammate health, powers, position and distance. See the Squads chapter.
projecthero.guide.mutation.body: 1. Study a research note to learn a mutation exists. 2. Craft the power’s reagent from obscure materials, then brew it with the listed base potion to make an unstable serum. 3. Drink the serum — you gain a temporary Unstable Mutation. 4. Before it fades, perform the required exposure event (a dangerous accident, or a laboratory device). 5. Survive it and the power is yours forever: UNUSUAL MUTATION DETECTED.
projecthero.guide.mutation.capacity: You may permanently own up to 3 minor mutations (server-configurable). Only one occupies the six ability slots at a time — switch with the power wheel. Switching never resets cooldowns or duplicates passives. Experimental mutations and a Hero-Tier power (Thor, Iron Man, Spider-Man, Max Steel) cannot be held at once: a mutated body rejects the Arc Reactor, the Steel and the Arachnid Mutagen, and taking a serum does nothing once you are a Hero. Give up your powers with a Power Suppressor to switch paths.
projecthero.guide.mutation.research: Research advances: Research Found → Serum Stabilized → Exposure Survived → Mutation Confirmed. Once confirmed, the full recipe is permanently recorded and reproducible for teammates.
projecthero.guide.structures.body: Six rare structures generate above ground across the Overworld. Explore to find them; each holds research notes, thematic ingredients and usually a laboratory device.
projecthero.guide.structure.research_fac: Brewing gear, copper/redstone machinery and a light projector. Linked to Flight, Laser Vision, Telekinesis, Wind and Gravity research.
projecthero.guide.structure.meteor_impac: A scorched crater with an unusual central crystal. Linked to Energy Absorption, Flight, Laser Vision and Density.
projecthero.guide.structure.power_statio: Coils, generators and an Overloaded Redstone Coil. Linked to Electrokinesis, Super Speed, Super Strength and Magnetism.
projecthero.guide.structure.geological_s: Lapis, amethyst and resonance equipment. Linked to Geokinesis, Crystalkinesis and Density.
projecthero.guide.structure.government_s: A rare fenced compound with prototype compression machines. Linked to Density, Size and Gravity.
projecthero.guide.structure.hydrostatic_: A small pump station near water with a Hydrostatic Test Tank. Linked to Water Manipulation.
projecthero.guide.devices.body: Craftable, reusable devices that reliably trigger a specific exposure event. Most fire on a redstone pulse; some on right-click. Stand within a few blocks with an active serum.
projecthero.guide.combos.body: Owning two complementary powers unlocks synergies (they apply passively where relevant):
projecthero.guide.thor.body: Thor is a Hero-Tier path, rarer and stronger than any minor mutation. Prove worthy, bind Mjolnir (sneak + right-click) to gain the Power of Thor (+10 melee, +10 hearts, permanent Resistance III, 250 Storm Energy). While holding Mjolnir: R Throw Mjolnir, Sneak + R Call Mjolnir, G Lightning Strike, X Lightning Beam (held), Z God of Thunder’s Wrath, V Thunderclap (10 Storm Energy), C Chain Lightning. God of Thunder’s Wrath is an 80-damage bolt at the point you are aiming at — it cannot be cast instantly: hold Z for 5 seconds to charge it (a bar shows the buildup), and it drains 150 Storm Energy. Double-tap jump while holding Mjolnir to fly. You cannot hold Thor’s power and an experimental mutation at the same time.

projecthero.guide.squads.body: A squad is a group of players who cannot hurt each other. Nothing one squadmate does lands on another — not a sword, not an arrow, not a grenade, not a repulsor beam, not a 55-damage Psychic Detonation. That is the whole point: these powers are built to level a hillside, and without a squad you cannot use half of them anywhere near a friend.
projecthero.guide.squads.commands.body: /squad create <name> starts one and makes you its leader. /squad invite <player> offers a place; the offer stands for a minute and the invited player gets a clickable ACCEPT, or can type /squad accept. /squad leave walks away, /squad kick and /squad rename and /squad disband are the leader’s, and plain /squad lists who is in yours. A squad holds up to 12, and survives a restart.
projecthero.guide.squads.menu.body: Press P at any time for the roster: each squadmate’s health, which hero identity or mutation is currently holding their ability slots, their coordinates, and how far away they are and in which direction. Squadmates in another dimension show the dimension instead of a bearing, and anyone offline is greyed out. It updates live while it is open.
projecthero.guide.zombie_raid.body: Somewhere out there is a Graveyard, and somewhere in the dark is a Cursed Zombie. Either one can make you Gravebound — and twenty minutes later, the dead come for you.
projecthero.guide.zombie_raid.curse.body: Twenty minutes of play. It survives logging out, dying, changing dimension, restarting the game, and milk. Only an Enchanted Golden Apple breaks it — everything else just delays the reckoning. The timer shows in the top-left while it runs.
projecthero.guide.zombie_raid.sources.bo: Activate the Cursed Grave in a Graveyard's crypt, or take a hit from a rare Cursed Zombie. Both lead to exactly the same curse: a second source never resets, extends or stacks your timer.
projecthero.guide.zombie_raid.waves.body: Risen and baby zombies, Armoured Zombies that shrug off arrows, Acid Zombies that deny ground, Sword Skeletons that hunt archers, and Juggernauts that charge. Powered Zombie Bosses arrive on waves 4, 8 and 12, each carrying one of the Experimental Powers.
projecthero.guide.zombie_raid.bosses.bod: An Empowered Zombie fights with a real power, not a bigger health bar. It picks its targets, follows fliers, closes on archers and saves its area attacks for crowds. Kill one for a heap of Grave Essence and a chance at its Empowered Zombie Head trophy.
projecthero.guide.zombie_raid.rewards.bo: Grave Essence from everything you kill; a Cursed Grave Chest after wave 12 with a pile of essence and — if you are lucky — a Gravekeeper Shield, a Necrotic Blade or an Undying Totem. Your first clear also yields a Heart of the Grave.
projecthero.guide.zombie_raid.crafting.b: Press four Grave Essence into a Gravebound Ingot. Two ingots and a stick forge a Necrotic Blade. Four ingots, four rotten flesh and a Totem of Undying make a Heart of the Grave — eat it and the next death that would kill you revives you like a held totem, once.
projecthero.guide.zombie_raid.repeat.bod: Craft the Heart of the Grave into a Grave Ritual Totem with Grave Essence, Soul Sand, Rotten Flesh and a Skeleton Skull. Use it in a Graveyard to curse yourself deliberately.
projecthero.guide.supervillain_raid.body: A rare assault on a village by one of three Supervillains and their raider army. It is not a vanilla raid, and it does not happen often — most players will go a long time between sightings of the scout that starts it.
Every so often a lone Pillager appears in the wild, sometimes with an escort, and heads for the nearest village. Look closely: the robe is darker, a faint purple particle drifts from it now and then, and its name shows on your crosshair. It is scouting the village for a Supervillain.
projecthero.guide.supervillain_raid.mark: If the Spy manages to land a hit on a player who is standing inside a village, that village is Marked for Attack. A miss does nothing; an ordinary Pillager does nothing; a hit outside the village does nothing. The mark belongs to the village, and a village that survives a raid is safe from another for a few days.
projecthero.guide.supervillain_raid.prep: Once marked, you have 10 minutes before the first wave. Warnings sound at 10, 5 and 1 minute and count down the final seconds. Use the time to build defences, protect the villagers, gather supplies, equip your gear and call for help. Leaving the village does not cancel the attack.
projecthero.guide.supervillain_raid.wave: Six waves. Waves 1-5 are escalating Pillagers, Vindicators, Witches, Evokers and Ravagers, each cleared before the next begins with 15 seconds to regroup. Wave 5 is the largest conventional wave — and then, after an ominous pause, wave 6 is the Supervillain itself. The raid bar counts all six, so "Wave 5 / 6" means there is still a boss to come.
projecthero.guide.supervillain_raid.vill: After wave 5 everything goes quiet. Then: SOMETHING POWERFUL IS APPROACHING. One of three villains arrives — the Chimera, the Arsenal or the Omega Mage — carrying a completely unpredictable superhero power, with a small escort. The appearance never tells you the power. Defeat the villain and the remaining raiders flee.
projecthero.guide.supervillain_raid.rewa: The Supervillain drops a large amount of experience, emeralds and a Villain Cache of high-level loot, and has a chance to drop a Supervillain Token, a Power Fragment of its power, and its unique trophy (Chimera Core, Arsenal Reactor or Omega Crystal). Everyone who fought becomes Champion of the Village for 30 minutes — improved village trades.

projecthero.spider_man.name: Spider-Man
projecthero.spider_man.desc: A Hero Class built entirely around movement. Swing across the sky, crawl over anything, and see trouble coming before it arrives.
projecthero.spider_man.ability.web_swing: Hold to fire a web and swing from it. Finds real anchors -- rooftops, cliffs, canopy, cave ceilings -- and fires one high ahead of you when there is nothing to catch. W builds momentum, S brakes, A and D steer, jump reels in, sneak lets out. Let go at the right moment and you keep every bit of the speed.
projecthero.spider_man.ability.web_zip.d: Fire at the surface you are looking at -- up to 100 blocks away -- and pull yourself to it, fast. Precision traversal: rooftops, ledges, the far side of a ravine, or a save on the way down.
A burst of webbing at what you are aiming at -- 2 damage, no cooldown, 2 webbing a shot. Every hit is a stickiness stack (max 3) that slows the target and weighs its jump down, worse each time; land the next hit within 3 seconds of the first to build it. The third stack wraps an ordinary mob in a full web cocoon for 12 seconds. Puts out fires, including your own.
Line something and haul. Light things come to you, heavy things pull you to them, and dropped items come flying -- from a ravine, a lava edge or anywhere you would rather not walk.
projecthero.spider_man.ability.wall_craw: Toggle. While on, touching any climbable surface in mid-air sticks you to it automatically -- no double-tap needed -- and sneaking locks you to that exact spot like a ladder rung. (Double-tap jump against a surface still works with it off.)
projecthero.spider_man.ability.web_net.d: Spin a temporary platform of webbing where you are aiming. A bridge, a floor, a landing pad or a trap. Dissolves on its own and puts back whatever it covered.
projecthero.spider_man.ability.web_bloss: Sneak and hold V for 3 seconds, then leap into the air and fire webbing in every direction. Everything within 20 blocks takes 40 damage and is trapped in cobwebs -- frozen in place -- for 20 seconds. Costs 75 webbing.

projecthero.guide.spider_man.body: You cannot become Spider-Man directly. It is what Spider Climbing / Adhesion grows into: the same adaptation, refined until it is something else. Everything Adhesion could do, this does better, and it replaces it outright -- you are never carrying both.
projecthero.guide.spider_man.step.adhesi: Mutate into Spider Climbing / Adhesion the ordinary way (Adhesive Mutation Serum, then survive a Cave Spider bite).
projecthero.guide.spider_man.step.mutage: Craft an Arachnid Mutagen: phantom membrane, an echo shard, spider eyes, fermented spider eyes, amethyst and a golden apple.
projecthero.guide.spider_man.step.evolve: Use it. With the adaptation already in you it evolves; without it, nothing happens and the mutagen is not consumed.
projecthero.guide.spider_man.passive.sen: Spider Sense -- a chime and a crosshair pulse point you at trouble before it lands: an attack winding up, a projectile closing in, a primed explosion, a bad fall, lava or a falling block. Move, jump or crouch during the warning for a guaranteed dodge.
projecthero.guide.spider_man.passive.dod: Half of all incoming attacks are simply dodged; a dodged projectile is caught, or sometimes flung back.
projecthero.guide.spider_man.passive.arr: Arrows you dodge are caught out of the air and kept.
projecthero.guide.spider_man.passive.cra: Wall crawling -- double-tap jump against a surface to grab it, then look where you want to go and move. Double-tap sneak, or reach the ground, to let go. Toggle Wall Crawl (C) to make surfaces stick automatically.
projecthero.guide.spider_man.passive.cei: Ceiling crawling, and clean transitions between wall and ceiling in both directions.
projecthero.guide.spider_man.passive.wal: Jump while clung to a wall to launch about 7 blocks in the exact direction you are looking, with a slight upward kick -- a wall leap.
projecthero.guide.spider_man.passive.dou: A second jump in mid-air, once every second.
projecthero.guide.spider_man.passive.sup: Sneak and jump from the ground to leap about 10 blocks straight up.
projecthero.guide.spider_man.passive.web: Web Blossom -- sneak and hold V for 3 seconds, then leap into the air and blast webbing outward. Everything within 20 blocks takes 40 damage and is frozen in cobwebs for 20 seconds. Costs 75 webbing.
projecthero.guide.spider_man.passive.str: An unarmed hit lands 8 damage (a sprint punch, 10), plus Speed II, Resistance II, a jump that clears 2 blocks, and solid resistance to being knocked around.
projecthero.guide.spider_man.passive.fal: Falls hurt far less, and a fall you web out of does not hurt at all.
projecthero.guide.spider_man.passive.res: Organic webbing -- no shooters, no ammunition, just a reserve that refills.
projecthero.guide.spider_man.swinging: Swinging prefers real terrain and always will: a city, a mountainside or a dense forest gives longer, faster, more dramatic arcs than open ground. Where there is genuinely nothing to catch, the web goes up and ahead anyway so traversal never stops -- but those swings will only carry you so far above where the run began, so webbing across a desert stays swinging rather than becoming flying. Climb real terrain and that limit rises with you.
projecthero.guide.spider_man.reserve: Every web ability spends from your Web Reserve, shown under the ability row. Swinging costs very little; combat webbing costs real amounts. It refills by itself a moment after you stop using it.
item.projecthero.turbo_stabilizer.tip1: Regulates unstable T.U.R.B.O. Energy during Ultralink bonding.
item.projecthero.turbo_stabilizer.tip2: Allows bonding with Steel without reaching Level 30.

projecthero.guide.max_steel.body: Maxwell McGrath generates raw T.U.R.B.O. Energy but cannot control it. Steel -- an alien Ultralink -- bonds with him to regulate that energy, form a nanotech suit around him, and channel it into specialised Turbo Modes.
projecthero.guide.max_steel.step.find: Find a Steel Crash Site -- a rare crater in the open Overworld with Steel floating at its centre. Use /locate structure projecthero:steel_crash_site if you have permission.
projecthero.guide.max_steel.step.bond: Right-click Steel while at Experience Level 30 or higher (this consumes 5 levels), or while carrying a T.U.R.B.O. Stabilizer (this consumes the Stabilizer, with no level requirement). The bond is permanent.
projecthero.guide.max_steel.energy.body: A pool of 250 that regenerates on its own -- 18/second out of combat, 9/second in combat, and not at all while a Turbo Mode is draining it or the Turbo Cannon is charging. If a Turbo Mode drains it to 0 you overload: you drop to Base Mode and cannot use any ability until natural regen brings T.U.R.B.O. Energy back up to 150. Turbo Modes have no time limit -- this pool is the only clock on them.
projecthero.guide.max_steel.controls: Press N to Go Turbo. Press Shift+H while transformed to power down (not in combat); press H alone to retract or seal the helmet. The HUD shows the six abilities with their cooldowns, the active mode, a T.U.R.B.O. Energy meter and whether you are IN COMBAT or READY. The six abilities only work while transformed -- and pressing a mode key (G/X/Z/V) while unsuited armours you up straight into that mode:
projecthero.guide.max_steel.ability.turb: Tap to fire a thick, fast T.U.R.B.O. energy bolt (10 damage) -- a real projectile now, not a hitscan. Hold to charge -- particles gather on your hand -- up to 22 damage with a small impact burst on hit.

Reconfigure into a heavier, 20%-larger form: Resistance I, +8 unarmed damage, but slower to move and swing. Crouch to brace and block 50% of incoming damage. Sprint into a melee hit for a Heavy Punch shockwave. Press G again for a Turbo Slam -- 15 damage to everything within 5 blocks. Shift+G returns to Base Turbo Mode.

Very high, controllable ground speed with automatic step-up (+4 unarmed damage, as Base). Tap again while active for a short Turbo Dash that hits the first thing in front of you; Shift+X returns to Base Turbo Mode.
Toggle flight -- blue T.U.R.B.O. wings deploy and an energy trail streams behind you. Movement keys steer, jump climbs, sneak drops, sprint boosts. Costs more the faster you go.
Near-total invisibility -- the suit fades, nearby hostiles lose track of you. Breaks the moment you attack or take a real hit, then goes on a 12-second cooldown.

Hold to brace and charge, release to launch yourself forward as a living cannonball. Instant-cast hits for 12; every extra second charged (up to 5) adds 5 more damage and costs more T.U.R.B.O. Energy. You take none of the impact yourself.
projecthero.guide.max_steel.passives.bod: Diamond-tier suit armour, +4 melee, some knockback resistance, half fall damage, a higher jump, passive Regeneration I, and you breathe underwater. Steel also chirps and marks the direction of a projectile you can't see coming.
projecthero.guide.max_steel.emergency.bo: If a hit would kill you while you are NOT transformed, Steel forces the suit online instead: the death is cancelled, you are healed and briefly shielded, and you Go Turbo on the spot. It costs 150 T.U.R.B.O. Energy and then will not fire again for 20 minutes. Being suited up when the blow lands does not trigger it -- power down somewhere safe, not mid-fight, to keep it in reserve.
projecthero.guide.punisher.body: Frank Castle is not superhuman. Everything he brings is a firearm, an explosive, a piece of tactical gear, or the training to use them. A Punisher never runs out of reserve ammunition, reloads faster, handles weapons more steadily, and finishes wounded enemies without hesitation.
projecthero.guide.punisher.step.safehous: Find a rare Abandoned Vigilante Safehouse -- a buried bunker with a weapon workbench, ammunition, target boards and a Vigilante Training Manual. Locate one with /locate structure projecthero:vigilante_safehouse.
projecthero.guide.punisher.step.training: Right-click the Manual to begin. Objectives: defeat 25 hostiles, 10 of them at range, land 5 firearm headshots, craft a firearm, and defeat a Pillager Captain. Complete them all and you permanently become the Punisher.
projecthero.guide.punisher.ammo: You (the Punisher) carry a personal reserve for each gun -- three full magazines' worth -- that drains as you reload and slowly refills on its own (about 1% every 0.7s). No ammo item is consumed. Anyone else may craft and fire these guns, but must carry the matching ammunition: Handgun Rounds, Rifle Rounds, Shotgun Shells or Sniper Rounds.
projecthero.guide.punisher.ability.arsen: Tactical Satchel -- press R to open a persistent 9-slot bag for weapons, ammo and gear. It rides with you through death, power changes and dimensions, but only opens while you wear the full Punisher tactical armour. Tap R while holding a gun to reload.
projecthero.guide.punisher.ability.grena: Frag Grenade -- hold G to cook, release to throw. It sticks to the first surface it touches instead of bouncing away, then explodes on its fuse. Hold too long and it goes off in your hand. 12s cooldown.
projecthero.guide.punisher.ability.roll: Tactical Roll -- a quick dive in your movement direction with brief knockback resistance and light damage reduction. Cancels an active reload. 4s cooldown.
projecthero.guide.punisher.ability.suppr: Suppressive Fire -- needs the Assault Rifle. For 8s: far less recoil and spread, a faster fire rate, and Slowness on anything you hit -- but you move slower. 20s cooldown.
projecthero.guide.punisher.ability.adren: Adrenaline -- for 20s: Regeneration V (first 3s), Resistance II, Haste II, Speed II, +25% reload speed and +15% firearm damage. Your own game audio dulls while it runs, and you take a Nausea crash for 10s once it wears off. 30s cooldown.
projecthero.guide.punisher.ability.c4: Explosive Charge -- press C at a surface to place a charge (up to 3). Sneak + C detonates every charge you placed. Stronger than a grenade, moderate terrain damage.
projecthero.guide.punisher.passives.body: Weapon Proficiency (a regenerating personal reserve of 3 magazines per gun, less recoil, faster handling), Faster Reloading (15%, does not stack with Adrenaline), Ballistic Expertise (tighter aim), Headshot Feedback, and No Mercy: +25% firearm damage to a non-boss hostile below 15% health (+10% to a boss).
projecthero.guide.punisher.crafting: Weapons are built from Weapon Parts (iron + copper + redstone), Gun Barrels and a Weapon Scope. The pistol is cheapest; the sniper is the most expensive. The Punisher Tactical Vest, Leggings and Boots (there is no helmet) protect between iron and diamond, and while you hold the power the full set adds 20% projectile-damage reduction, knockback resistance and a little less recoil.
projecthero.guide.symbiote.body: An alien symbiotic lifeform that bonds to a host and covers them in a living black suit, sharing its strength, agility and regeneration -- at the cost of a hostile reaction to loud sound. Unlike the Hero Classes, the Symbiote can bond with any player, whatever else they already are.
projecthero.guide.symbiote.step.find: Find a loose Symbiote -- it drifts free in the world, crashes to earth inside a meteor crater, waits in a hidden research lab, or tears itself free of a rare mutated hostile mob it was riding when that mob dies.
projecthero.guide.symbiote.step.bond: Right-click it. A wild Symbiote does not click cleanly into place — it spreads through you over about half a minute. During that time you have its protection but none of its abilities, and your body fights it: nausea, weakness, the shakes. Ride it out. Once it settles, press H to let the suit take hold, and H again to retract it. (An operator granting the Symbiote with a command skips the settling.)
projecthero.guide.symbiote.host.normal: Anyone else becomes a Normal Host: plain black living armour with its own six tendril, mobility and defence abilities.
projecthero.guide.symbiote.host.spider_m: A player who already holds Spider-Man becomes Black Suit Spider-Man instead -- the GeckoLib black suit, keeping every web ability, plus three sneak-modified Symbiote extras layered onto Spider-Man's own keys rather than new ones.
projecthero.guide.symbiote.controls.body: Only a Normal Host uses these six -- Black Suit Spider-Man keeps Spider-Man's own web abilities instead (see below).
projecthero.symbiote.ability.tendril_gra: Shift+G: lash a tendril and suspend a target helpless in front of you. Press the ability again to hurl it away.
projecthero.symbiote.ability.tendril_str: R: a tendril lash out to 30 blocks for real damage and a solid knockback. Shift+R: Tendril Sweep -- a fan of tendrils that hits everything in front of you and slows it for 7 seconds.
projecthero.symbiote.ability.leap.desc: X: a pure directional dash -- the Symbiote hurls you exactly where you are looking, with no added lift. Aim past an enemy and you will sail clean over them. You take no fall damage at all until you next land, however far it carries you.
G: fire a spread of living spikes at whatever is in the narrow cone ahead of you -- up to three targets, out to 26 blocks. Sneak+G grabs a target instead; press G again while holding one to hurl it.
projecthero.symbiote.ability.grapple.des: Sneak + X: fire a tendril up to 30 blocks and reel yourself to it -- no fall damage on the landing. Aim at a dropped item and it is pulled to you instead.
projecthero.symbiote.ability.slam.desc: A short-range ground slam that damages and knocks back everything nearby. No terrain damage.
projecthero.symbiote.ability.onslaught.d: The ultimate. Hold for 3 seconds to charge, then release to engulf every nearby enemy in living black symbiote -- blinding and slowing them and decaying them for 10 damage over 5 seconds. 60-second cooldown; releasing early cancels it for free.
projecthero.symbiote.ability.shield.desc: Hold to raise a living shield just in front of you. It works like a real shield -- it stops almost all damage from your front, nothing from the side or back -- and you are slowed while it holds. Drains a 9-second guard bar.
projecthero.symbiote.ability.frenzy.desc: An aggressive burst -- more damage, more speed, more knockback resistance -- with a brief defence dip once it wears off.
projecthero.symbiote.ability.barrage.des: Z: a rapid flurry of tendril strikes raking everything in front of you for about a second. Longer cooldown. Shift + hold Z charges Symbiote Onslaught, the ultimate, slowing every enemy in range while it winds up and while it decays them. With Symbiote Blade out, Z is a wide slashing arc instead.
projecthero.symbiote.ability.blade.desc: V: your arm becomes a living black blade -- +5 melee, swings 50% faster, bites past armour -- draining a bar that lasts about 15 seconds and refills while sheathed. You cannot hold an item while it is out. Shift+V toggles Symbiote Shield.
projecthero.symbiote.ability.spikes.desc: C: raise living spikes -- attackers in melee take reflected damage, like Thorns IV.

projecthero.guide.symbiote.black_suit.bo: Sneak + Web Yank's key -- Symbiote Tendril Strike, a short-range tendril hit for real damage and a knockback. Sneak + Web Shot's key, held -- Symbiote Crush, locking a target within 10 blocks and crushing it for 8 damage a second for up to 5 seconds. Sneak + the wall-crawl toggle's key -- Symbiote Slam, driving you into the ground for a 15-damage shockwave when airborne, an ordinary slam when grounded. All are paced by their own cooldowns, shown in the HUD next to the usual six web-ability boxes.
projecthero.symbiote.ability.symbiote_te: A short-range tendril lash for real damage and a solid knockback -- the same hit the Normal host's Tendril Strike lands, not a pull.
projecthero.symbiote.ability.symbiote_cr: Look at a target within 10 blocks and hold to crush it in the symbiote -- 8 damage a second for up to 5 seconds, black particles covering it the whole time. Release to let go.
projecthero.symbiote.ability.symbiote_sl: Airborne, it drives you straight down into the ground for a 15-damage black-symbiote shockwave on impact. On the ground it is just an ordinary slam where you stand.
projecthero.guide.symbiote.passive.bioma: Biomass -- the Symbiote's own 200-point life bar. Every hit still lands on you in full, but the Symbiote also loses 40% of that damage from its Biomass. Out of combat for 5 seconds it repairs itself at 3% per second. At zero Biomass every Symbiote ability locks until it has recovered.
projecthero.guide.symbiote.passive.recov: Symbiote Recovery -- noticeably faster natural regeneration than an ordinary player.
projecthero.guide.symbiote.passive.bare_: Living Claws -- your empty hand mines and harvests like a wooden pickaxe, axe and shovel all at once.
projecthero.guide.symbiote.weakness.soni: Loud sound briefly disrupts every Symbiote ability, and sonic attacks hurt 50% more while suited.
projecthero.guide.symbiote.weakness.fire: Fire, lava and sound all hurt 50% more while suited, and weaken you while you are in contact with them. Stay in contact for 5 seconds straight and the Symbiote retreats -- the suit retracts and cannot be called back for 10 seconds. The bond itself is never lost.
projecthero.guide.symbiote_spider_man.bo: A Symbiote that bonded with an existing Spider-Man: the living black suit over the web-slinger's own gear. Every web ability stays on its usual keys -- the Symbiote layers three sneak-modified extras on top instead of asking for new ones.
projecthero.guide.symbiote_spider_man.pa: +30% melee damage on top of Spider-Man's own strength.
Web Reserve capacity doubled -- a permanent perk of the bond, kept even with the suit retracted.
Symbiote Recovery -- noticeably faster natural regeneration than an ordinary player.
